subject: PHYS
title: Physics – Form 5
source: Form 5 scheme of work 2026-27, 3 periods/week, 63 h a year; dates worked out from the week numbers

chapters.title: Module 1 – Fields: magnetic fields and their effects

lessons.title: First contact and presentation of the scheme of work
1.0–1.1 Magnets: magnetic and non-magnetic substances; identifying magnets
1.2 Law of magnetism; applications; making magnets and caring for them; hard and soft magnetic materials
1.3–1.4 Magnetic field and flux patterns (bar magnet, the earth, horseshoe magnet, two poles)
1.5 Magnetic effect of a current: straight conductor and solenoid
Force on a current-carrying conductor in a magnetic field; principle of the electric motor
1.6 Electromagnetic induction: Faraday's law
Lenz's law and conservation of energy
1.7 Alternating current; mutual inductance
The transformer: energy losses, turns ratio
Efficiency, practical transformers and power transmission; applications

chapters.title: Module 2 – Environmental protection: modern physics and basic electronics

lessons.title: 2.0–2.1 The nuclear model of the atom; the electron (Q = Ne)
2.2–2.3 The nucleus; nuclear stability; radioactivity and decay equations
2.4 Radioactive decay: α, β and γ and their properties; cloud chamber
2.5 Half-life; importance and use of isotopes; background radiation
2.6–2.7 Uses of radioactive isotopes; safety and hazards of radioactivity
2.8 Semiconductors: intrinsic and extrinsic, p-type and n-type; p-n junctions and rectification
3.1–3.2 Vector and scalar quantities; forces: types, resolution, free-body diagrams, Archimedes' principle
3.3–3.4 Mass and weight; turning effect of forces: moments, couples
3.5 Linear motion: distance, displacement, speed, velocity, acceleration; motion graphs
3.6 Uniformly accelerated motion; free fall; experiment to determine g
3.7 Linear momentum: conservation of momentum
3.8 Newton's laws of motion
Preservation and maintenance of appliances; the essential elements of a repair box
Understanding the labelling on appliances
Techniques for dismantling and assembling appliances (FOLI and LIFO)
